# Fix-It Saturday at St. Ansgar

**Saturday, December 5, 2026 • 9 a.m.–1 p.m.**  
**Fellowship Hall, St. Ansgar Lutheran Church, Minneapolis**  
**Enter by the alley door (ramp access).**

Neighbors, gather up that lamp with the loose switch, the bike with the balky brakes, and the toaster that has given up. I confess I’m thrilled to announce our first Fix-It Saturday.

Our volunteer fixers will tackle small appliances, lamps, bikes, clothing mending, and knife sharpening. We’ll also have a retired tech fellow looking at laptops and phones. Doris Lindqvist, 84, who has darned socks for this parish since the Carter years, asked to run the mending table herself.

The idea was born when Marv Okafor fixed my 1970s Hamilton Beach mixer in twenty minutes right in the church kitchen. Too much gets thrown away when all it needs is a screw, a new cord, or somebody who knows what they’re looking at.

This is good neighboring, plain and simple. It is **free and open to everyone**—no church membership, no sign-up, no strings, and nobody will preach at you. Donations to the food shelf are welcome, but not expected.

To keep the line moving, please bring **one item per person to start**. Coffee and kringle will be provided, so bring the broken toaster *and* stay for coffee.

After December, we’ll continue on the **first Saturday of every month through spring**.

**We need more volunteer fixers**, especially anyone who knows their way around vacuum cleaners or zippers. If you can help—or if you have questions—please contact the church office at **office@stansgarlutheran.example** or **612-555-0148**.

Bring what’s broken. Have a cup of coffee. Let’s see what we can put back to work.
